entities.name: Grigori
entities.description: Young man of Stensia who cares for his mother and collects blood for the vampires' tithe.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire whose decree demands a nightly blood tithe.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: Massacre after which Grigori's mother fell into a prolonged sleep.

events.summary: Grigori collects his and his mother's blood to meet Olivia Voldaren's nightly blood tithe.
events.quote: Grigori was regularly tasked with collecting his and his mother's blood

relations.note: Her decree demands a nightly blood tithe from him.
relations.quote: the vampire Olivia Voldaren 's decree demanding a nightly blood tithe from each resident
